title: grouplootframe
summary: Benilla ships the full Need/Greed/Pass roll dialog family (4 stacked DIALOG popups, BoP gold-backdrop swap, CONFIRM_LOOT_ROLL popup, 60s timer bar, START/CANCEL/UPDATE_LOOT_ROLL driver). MSUIClient has no group-loot roll surface at all: no roll dialog, no LOOT_ROLL/START_ROLL/ALL_PASSED opcodes in Net/Opcodes.cs, no CMSG_LOOT_ROLL sender. The only trace is the UiParent managed-frame placement row (UiParentManagedConsumer.GroupLoot, BaseY 60) waiting for a consumer, plus CMSG_LOOT_METHOD (setting the group loot method) in WorldSession.

openItems.text: No GroupLootFrame dialog (icon, name plate, Pass/Need/Greed buttons, countdown StatusBar) exists anywhere in MSUI
SMSG_LOOT_START_ROLL / SMSG_LOOT_ROLL / SMSG_LOOT_ROLL_WON / SMSG_LOOT_ALL_PASSED not decoded (absent from Opcodes.cs)
No 4-frame stacking / UIParent managed-position consumer wired (the GroupLoot placement row in UiParentUiLaw is currently unused)
